cost_estimate.source: UNMEASURED PLACEHOLDER: positive scalar required by the existing selector schema. No Quartz candidate durations have been calibrated; the prior valid-control elapsed time is not used as a mutation-cost estimate.

registration.positive_control_scope: One fixed workload on four routes; not generated-pool execution. Earlier startup/authentication/automation diagnostics are documented there.
registration.mutation_selection_basis: Systematic finite representative catalog declared by field/type category before any Quartz boundary execution: one requestsRecovery toggle; optional description omission/null/empty/Unicode; five ordinary JSON map-value categories; optional map omission/null; three separate unresolved raw-key policy probes. All five v1 rejection variants are retained. No category was chosen or removed using runtime fault yield.

parent_registration.relationship: Separately versioned mixed accepted-value/normalization/rejection registry; v1 remains unchanged as the rejection/control stratum.

registration.freeze_status: not_frozen; Quartz registry adapter and protocol/policy review remain required

pinned_sources.equivalence: GitHub comparison between release and checkout modifies only README.md.

quartz_library_source.interpretation: Default description null; default empty data map; builder copies supplied map; getter supplies empty map if unset. These are source-level normalization expectations.

native_ui_actions: populate fixed job group/name and command fields

oracle.input_semantics: Operation inputs are templates for JSON request bodies. Group/name are separate resource-path bindings. A future adapter must resolve accepted output bindings before editing and must never replace an accepted producer-mutated field with the baseline template.
execution_conditions: No v1 or v2 boundary candidate has run. The existing fixed positive-control script does not consume this generated pool. A registry adapter and protocol/policy review are required before execution or freeze.
Any future executor must use the documented matching official 5.0.1 UI/backend artifacts, complete dependency classpath and Europe/Rome JVM timezone without application source changes.
Restart the native process independently for every complete case; verify the empty RAM store, same admin/ROLE_ADMIN principal, scheduler STOPPED, zero triggers and zero executions.
Send exactly the declared one-property API mutation, leaving the other producer fields fixed. Do not start/resume the scheduler, create a trigger, or invoke job execution.
Record producer status and body, then read stored jobs regardless of success or rejection. A rejected creation must leave the reset state unchanged; rejection alone does not prove rollback.
If creation rejects, stop the continuation. Do not fabricate a resource key, mark dependency coverage, count an unattempted consumer as passed, or treat declared target edges as observed.

If creation accepts, retain its response and a fresh stored-state read. For accepted/normalization variants, evaluate the declared producer semantics and bind returned identity/class/recovery/map values without restoring baseline templates. For rejected-class variants that unexpectedly accept, record actual state without repairing the class. For unresolved key-policy variants, keep raw keys and assign no intended-policy verdict.

For a UI consumer, use a fresh native session and verify the loaded typed values against bound producer state, with only the explicit null-description display projection. Change description only. For ordinary accepted variants require preservation of the bound map and recovery flag. For key-policy variants record native key trimming, blank/duplicate errors or successful submission as observations; do not prelabel them defects or silently normalize them in the oracle.

For an API consumer, GET the same bound resource and PUT the bound complete command with only description changed. Record actual status and state rather than requiring all rejection probes to reach this step.

After an accepted continuation, perform fresh API and native UI reads, compare the listed fields under the variant-specific policy, require the requested description and verify the listed inactive-scheduler/zero-trigger/zero-execution conditions. Separate policy-unknown map differences from failures of declared accepted-value expectations.

Source expectations are hypotheses for conformance checking. Record actual rejection status separately, including 4xx versus 5xx; this registration does not prescribe status codes, label defects or credit selector coverage.
The generic generator does not validate or resolve opaque oracle bindings. A future adapter must implement and validate the declared resource and state bindings before any candidate execution.

The map-key stratum requires independent contract/policy adjudication before binary conformance or defect claims. Predicted source behavior is not observed execution; no expected 4xx/5xx status is invented.

business_state_comparison.description: Requested meaningful edit after accepted continuation; original producer description before it.
business_state_comparison.normalization: JSON object-key order only for persisted business-state comparisons. Apply the separately declared null-description-to-empty UI display projection and omitted/null-map-to-empty stored normalization at their specified stages. Do not trim raw keys or collapse post-trim duplicates in oracle input. This scope does not compare every scheduler response field.
business_state_comparison.variant_policy: For accepted/normalization variants, compare raw persisted producer fields to variant_semantics and project only documented UI display representations; after continuation compare bound non-edited fields plus requested description. For unresolved key-policy variants, retain raw map keys and record differences or UI blocking separately without a binary key-policy verdict. Compare only the listed business and environment fields.

scope_limits.enum_kind: enum means an explicitly enumerated JSON literal, including complete object-valued jobDataMap inputs. It does not assert an API enum or implement nested-key, random-value, Unicode-range or fuzz operators.
scope_limits.native_ui_exclusions: Forty UI-producer mutation combinations are excluded by the unchanged API-only generator. Ordinary accepted literals have plausible native control representations, whereas exact omission/null and raw whitespace/blank/post-trim duplicate key payloads have no matching native submission mapping. These reasons are separated in each transformation.
scope_limits.path_constraints: Group/name URL syntax, defaults, trimming and collisions are outside the object-property mutation schema. They are fixed here and require a separately specified path/state adapter before probing.
scope_limits.dynamic_allowed_values: Eligible job classes depend on the pinned classpath and configured packages. The generator neither discovers nor enforces that list. The fixed SampleJob control and java.lang.String exclusion are justified by pinned source.
scope_limits.fields_held_fixed: durable remains true; job group/name remain RESEARCH/pilot-job. Each case changes at most one producer DTO property. The consumer changes only description, binds accepted producer state and applies no repair. requestsRecovery, description and jobDataMap vary only over the registered finite representatives.
scope_limits.unmodeled_variants: No simultaneous mutations, path fuzzing, duplicate fixture creation, scheduler lifecycle, triggers, job execution, timing, recovery behavior or persistence mode changes.
scope_limits.interpretation: Source-only preparation. Four prior ordinary controls do not validate generated variants. The catalog adds no observation-based coverage, fault yield, prevalence, held-out generalization or oracle effectiveness evidence.
scope_limits.evaluation_stratum: v2 provides a prospective mixed catalog with accepted-value, normalization, rejection and unresolved-key-policy strata. No generated candidate has executed, and meaningful oracle evaluation remains pending a Quartz registry adapter and protocol review. No freeze or effectiveness claim is made.
scope_limits.map_key_policy: Whitespace-surrounded, blank and post-trim-colliding keys form a separate unknown/unresolved policy stratum. Source differences motivate observation, not an intended business rule or defect label. Raw keys must remain available for adjudication.
scope_limits.unsupported_dimensions: No dynamic object-key mutation operator, duplicate raw JSON member representation, path mutation, simultaneous field mutation, arbitrary-number stress, complete Unicode coverage, trigger generation or recovery execution is implemented. Map variants use explicit whole-property JSON replacements supported by the existing enum operator.
